messages:
alex: quick check — AcmeCorp SCIM calls started returning 504s overnight. Our current retry policy is 3 attempts (1s, 2s, 4s). Should we extend retries for enterprise clients or is this masking an upstream issue? also: can we log user emails to debug or must we keep them redacted? pinging @maya @jen

maya: short answer on logs — redact by default. If you need emails for debugging do a short-lived unredacted trace (requires ticket + security approval). Permanent exceptions need SOC sign-off. :eyes:

jen: on SCIM side — AcmeCorp does a lot of nested group writes which spikes processing time. Increasing retries helps with transient infra failures but could create duplicated work if the idempotency header isn't honored. Can you paste the headers/body you send?

alex: here's what we send currently:
```
POST /scim/v2/Users
Authorization: Bearer xxxxx
Idempotency-Key: user-1234-patch-1617981372
Content-Type: application/json
{ "schemas": [...], "Operations": [...] }
```
and infra retry config (current):
```json
{ "max_attempts": 3, "backoff": { "base_seconds": 1, "factor": 2, "max_seconds": 8 }, "retry_on": [503, 504] }
```

sam: we do set Idempotency-Key but some downstream IdP endpoints ignore it. Two suggestions: honor `Retry-After` for 429s and increase attempts to 5 for enterprise tenants. Proposed new policy:
```json
{ "max_attempts": 5, "backoff": { "base_seconds": 1, "factor": 2, "max_seconds": 30 }, "honor_retry_after": true, "route_queue": "scim-retry-lowprio" }
```
This reduces tight hot-loop retries and keeps main queue responsive.

ryan: infra +1 for 5 attempts but only for reserved/dedicated customers. Also: make retries go to a separate worker queue so prolonged retries don't exhaust normal provisioning workers. We should also expose a metric for retry_count so we can alert.

maya: approvals/process: For increasing retry window we need a short security review (non-blocking) documenting duplicate-op mitigation and idempotency guarantees. For unredacted logs: open a ticket with customer ID, exact time window, reason, and TTL (max 24h). Security will approve scoped traces; permanent unredacted logging not allowed. :thumbsup:

alex: thanks. I'll draft the PR + runbook. Quick question — who can approve a one-off 24h unredacted trace if we need it? @jen?

jen: I can approve a 24h scoped trace. Please include the ticket with customer contact, expected trace ids, and auto-redact TTL in the ticket. We'll require post-mortem notes in the ticket too.

alex: will open SF-789 with details and attach sample traces. i'll also add `scim_retry_count` metric + dashboard panel per-tenant.

idp-bot: idp-bot: Alert: SCIM client AcmeCorp — 3 failed provisioning requests (504) in last 12h. trace_id: x-9a8b.

sam: small follow-up: add a feature-flag gated rollout for the new retry policy (start with AcmeCorp, then 10% tenants, then all). also add a flag to disable email logging even in traces unless explicitly allowed.

alex: sounds good. i'll open the PR with feature flag + metrics + runbook and tag @maya @ryan @jen for review. will update thread with PR link.

maya: thanks — and reminder: ensure logs redact emails by default and store any unredacted traces in a short-lived, access-controlled bucket with ACLs and audit logs.

alex: noted. will include retention and ACL steps in runbook. Thanks everyone.
